name: Navy Beans
siboNotes: Navy beans are high in galactans (GOS) which can ferment in the small intestine. Limit to 2 tablespoons or less if tolerated during SIBO treatment phases.
preparationTips: Soak dried beans overnight and rinse thoroughly before cooking to reduce oligosaccharides
Cook beans thoroughly and add digestive spices like ginger or fennel seeds
Start with very small portions (1-2 tablespoons) to test tolerance
Consider canned beans which may be slightly better tolerated than dried
alternatives: Eggs or chicken for complete protein without FODMAPs
pairsWellWith: Fresh herbs like parsley or chives
nutritionalHighlights: High in plant-based protein and fiber
Good source of iron and potassium
Contains resistant starch for gut health
